svg.text: 0.75 partially supported or directly stated relationship
dashed outline = cell inside a coupled block
D2 ↔ D3: design and weight iterate.
D4 ↔ D6: software and flight test iterate.
D6 → D6: rework inside flight test (diagonal exception).
D8 is a terminal sink: its row is all zero.
Update: x(t+1) = W^T x(t); a node sums its column (its sources).
Spectral radius 0.9114 (from the D4/D6 block): decays.
